welcome.speaker: scientist
welcome.text: Aha! Welcome, junior scientist! Professor Pip here! Two samples. Same color, same appearance. Obviously the same substance! Case closed! I would test them, of course, but my genius is usually faster! See that big button? Go on! Confirm my brilliance!

welcome.speaker: robot
welcome.text: Beep. Confidence: one hundred percent. Evidence collected: zero. I recommend the button.

testing.speaker: scientist
testing.text: Aha! Sample A turns blue! Beautiful! Completely predicta...

reveal.speaker: scientist
reveal.text: Extraordinary! We have discovered two things! Appearances can fool us... and I need a hat! You saw that, right? Same-looking liquids. Different color results! My theory could use a little work. So could my hair!

reveal.speaker: robot
reveal.text: Updating case file. Sample A: blue. Sample B: pink. Updating hairstyle: spectacular. The giant puff is our cartoon joke. The different colors are our evidence.

handoff.speaker: robot
handoff.text: Four unlabeled vials. One unsolved case. Perhaps YOU should lead this investigation. Collect observations. Compare tests. Find the evidence that Professor Pip skipped.

handoff.speaker: scientist
handoff.text: I shall supervise! From a slightly greater distance! Go on, detective! Give those mystery vials an explanation worth believing! And if anyone asks... this hairstyle was intentional!
